nodes.name: Determine Origin + At-Home for New Event

parameters.jsCode:
// Online events: no commute, no departure time, no weather.
// Only remind_60 and remind_15 relative to start_time.
const user = $('Loop Users').item.json;
const newEvent = $('Loop New Events').item.json;
const calStart = newEvent.start?.dateTime || newEvent.start?.date;
const calEnd = newEvent.end?.dateTime || newEvent.end?.date;
const start = new Date(calStart);

const remind60 = new Date(start.getTime() - 60 * 60 * 1000);
const remind15 = new Date(start.getTime() - 15 * 60 * 1000);

return { json: {
  event_id: newEvent.id,
  user_id: user.user_id,
  plan_date: $now.toFormat('yyyy-MM-dd'),
  title: newEvent.summary || '(no title)',
  location: '',
  location_coords: '',
  start_time: calStart,
  end_time: calEnd,
  origin_coords: '',
  origin_type: '',
  at_home: true,
  is_online: true,
  is_tentative: $('Classify New Event').item.json.is_tentative,
  ntfy_topic: user.ntfy_topic,
  departure_time: '',
  commute_minutes: 0,
  commute_mode: '',
  weather_worst: '',
  clothing_advice: '',
  remind_dressed: '',
  remind_60: remind60.toISOString(),
  remind_30: '',
  remind_15: remind15.toISOString(),
  remind_now: '',
  reminders_sent: '',
  current_state: 'planned',
  state_version: 0,
  sync_updated: $now.toISO(),
  departed_at: '',
  _departure_within_2h: false
}};

main.node: Determine Origin + At-Home for New Event
